settings.editor: Three equal payments over the length of the course, with no interest and no paperwork.

settings.title: What if I miss a class?

settings.editor: Every session is summarised in writing, and the instructor holds a catch-up half hour before the next class.

settings.title: Do I need my own laptop?

settings.editor: For the code, data and design courses, yes. Any laptop from the last six years will do. We lend a few each term.
Yes, if you attend at least eight in ten sessions and finish the project. It lists what you made, not only that you were there.

settings.title: Can I get my money back?

settings.editor: In full until the second class. After that, we move your place to a later group at no cost.
